name: Coral reef intelligence
tile: Open AI models and 3D photogrammetry for reef surveys and restoration.
lead: Reef surveys produce more images than scientists can classify by hand. We build open segmentation models and 3D reconstruction methods that turn survey photos into coral cover and structure measurements.

whatWeDo.title: Image segmentation
whatWeDo.text: Coral AI labels reef photos by coral type, algae, rubble and sand, so transect cover estimates come straight from survey images.

whatWeDo.title: 3D photogrammetry
whatWeDo.text: Diver-captured image sets become 3D reef models for rugosity, growth and restoration tracking.

whatWeDo.title: Restoration monitoring
whatWeDo.text: Before-and-after measurement of restoration sites, reported in the format partners and funders need.

name: Mangroves and blue carbon
tile: Survival, growth and carbon monitoring for community restoration.
lead: Restoration projects need survival, growth and carbon estimates that funders and communities can trust. We provide the monitoring layer, from field records to reporting, alongside local partners who lead the work.

whatWeDo.title: Field data collection
whatWeDo.text: GPS-tagged records of planting, survival and growth, collected by community teams in their own language and working offline.

whatWeDo.title: Growth and carbon estimation
whatWeDo.text: Models that estimate growth and carbon uptake from field records, currently being calibrated with partner data.

whatWeDo.title: Adaptation and finance reporting
whatWeDo.text: Monitoring outputs shaped for ecosystem-based adaptation funders and blue carbon feasibility work.

name: Coastal water and earth observation
tile: Satellite, sensor and field data combined into indicators and reports.
lead: Coastal authorities now report ecosystem condition under the EU Nature Restoration Regulation and the Water Framework Directive. We combine satellite water quality products, in-situ data and field observations from partners into indicators and reports.

whatWeDo.title: Data integration
whatWeDo.text: Satellite products from specialist providers, sensor and vessel data and field observations, harmonised by site and reporting period.

whatWeDo.title: Bloom and debris detection R&D
whatWeDo.text: Algae Tracker and Plastic Tracker tested Copernicus Sentinel-2 and -3 detection of cyanobacteria and floating debris.

whatWeDo.title: Reporting for obligations
whatWeDo.text: Indicators and reports structured for Nature Restoration Regulation and Water Framework Directive reporting, delivered with accredited partners.

name: Field programmes and open innovation
tile: Coral Lab, open AI challenges and student research with partners.
lead: Technology for the ocean improves when the people closest to the problem help build it. We run challenges, host student research and work inside partner programmes such as the Coral Lab in Lombok.

whatWeDo.title: Partner field programmes
whatWeDo.text: Coral Lab in Lombok, built in 2021 with Indonesia Biru Foundation and TU Delft students, and run by IBF.

whatWeDo.title: Open AI challenges
whatWeDo.text: Six challenges since 2021 with FruitPunch AI, Sustainable Ocean Alliance, OceanHub Africa, Zindi and others.

whatWeDo.title: Student and thesis research
whatWeDo.text: MSc and minor projects with TU Delft and the University of Amsterdam that produce open methods and models.
